newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia bond yields up a little for small tender.
newsitem.headline: Australia bond yields up a little for small tender.

text.p: *Australian bond yields rose slightly during a slow session, and as the market made room for Tuesday's T-bond tender, although the offering is relatively small at A$500 million.
*This week's data not seen changing view on policy easing.
The offering comprises A$200 million of the October 2007 bond, the current 10-year benchmark stock, and A$300 million in the September 2009 bond.

Otherwise there were few fresh trading incentives with a 1/2 point easing in monetary policy priced in, leaving the market little scope to progress the rally until the RBA endorses the move, which is seen likely after the August 5 board meeting.

This week's data for June building approvals and retail trade on Wednesday and Thursday is also unlikely to change the market's view on the policy outlook, although they may give a clue as to whether this rate cut will be the last this cycle.
